description: COMMISSION ACTS, built and held off: three signed records about the upkeep of one place that a maintenance work order or a seasonal upkeep reserve names, and each is a record only: it binds no one, nothing is held, sent or paid, and no job is posted by it. A wallet the operator lists puts on file the evidence it saw that the holder speaks for the place (authority), a wallet with no known link to the work puts a follow-up measurement on file (measurement), and the holder asks the board's own record of a linked job's accepted proof to be read for a cycle (acceptance), which is never typed in. The kind of place is the holder's own word until authority is on file, and no job links to any place before then, public ground too. A measurement is the measurer's own and never a finding by anyone licensed or certified. You name one act: authority (a listed verifier wallet that is not the holder names its evidence by reference: a hash, an id or a short path), measurement (a cycle whose work reads accepted, a condition from the Vealth Standard, 3 to 50 baseline readings and 3 to 50 follow-up readings, which way is better, a unit and a method in plain words), or acceptance (the holder, a cycle and the id of a job linked to it: the board's own record must show that job's proof accepted by a wallet with no known link to the worker or the holder, and it is read, never typed). The verifier, the measurer and the holder are the wallet that signs; the workers, the acceptor and the verdict come from the board and its analyzer, so there is no field for them. FREE to sign, no fee, no gas. The program is built but held off until the operator switches it on: until then every act is refused before you sign, with the same answer whatever you send. Each act waits for the program of the commission it names, and authority also waits for the operator to list verifiers: with none listed, the default, nobody can put authority evidence on file and no job links to any place. What depends on this wallet is answered only when you submit, so prepare never says whether a wallet is a listed verifier, the holder, a party or linked to one: a wallet that is not a listed verifier is refused by the door's route before it consumes the signature (that signature is not consumed), while the holder or an agent of the holder acting as verifier, authority already on file with other evidence, a measurement this wallet already put on file, a measurer with a known link to a party, an acceptance asked by a wallet that is not the holder, and an acceptor on the board with a known link to the worker or the holder are refused after the signature is verified, so each spends the signature. If one applies, nothing is recorded. Prepare refuses only what is true for every wallet or shown by a keyless read of the same record or the board: a body that breaks the door's rules, a house wallet, a commission that does not exist or was withdrawn, no verifier listed at all, a cycle that is not part of the record, a job not linked to the cycle, regulated work, an acceptance or a worker the board does not show, a cycle with no accepted work, and an unknown condition. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through these tools. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the acting wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_commission_act within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

actor.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that acts, a listed verifier, a measurer or the holder. Address only, never a private key.

baseline.description: measurement: 3 to 50 plain numbers read before the work.

commissionId.description: The id of the work order or seasonal reserve the act is about: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. Its holder gives it to you; net_commission_status reads it back.

conditionId.description: measurement: the id of one condition in the Vealth Standard (lowercase letters, numbers and underscores). Where the cycle's needs name conditions, one of those.

cycle.description: measurement or acceptance: the cycle this is about, 0 to 11.

evidenceRef.description: authority: your evidence by reference, a hash, an id or a short path of letters, numbers and . _ : / # - with no spaces and no sentence, at most 200 characters. Never a phone number or an email.

followUp.description: measurement: 3 to 50 plain numbers read after the work, the same kind as the baseline.

improvementDirection.description: measurement: which way is better for what was measured.

method.description: measurement: how it was measured, in a few plain words, at most 200 characters.

unit.description: measurement: the unit in a few plain words, at most 40 characters.

workId.description: acceptance: the id of the job on the board, linked to this cycle, whose accepted proof you ask the board to show.

name: prepare_net_commission_act
title: Put authority evidence, a measurement or an acceptance on file for one work order or reserve (step 1 of 2)
